subject: Security gating: audit logs / BYOK / SSO prioritization
messages:
From: Dr. Amrita Singh <amrita@medsys.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security intake / audit evidence request

Hi team,

Following our procurement pre-check, we need to confirm a few gating items before Legal signs the cloud annex:
- Audit log retention options (default + adjustable windows, export capability)
- BYOK: can we provide customer-managed keys for encryption at rest, and what rotation guarantees do we offer?
- SSO: SAML metadata and which attributes are emitted for user mapping

Target: evidence pack by Nov 18 to satisfy our internal review board. Happy to join a short call to clarify.

Thanks,
Amrita
Director, Compliance — MedSys Health
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Amrita Singh <amrita@medsys.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security intake / audit evidence request

Amrita — thanks for the clear list. Quick triage from our side and proposed next steps: 

Questions for scoping (please confirm):
1) Retention windows: do you need immutable retention (legal hold) or export-on-demand is sufficient?
2) BYOK: is HSM-backed key storage required or will a KMS integration with customer keys suffice?
3) SSO: do you require SCIM for provisioning or only SAML assertions for authentication?

Proposed immediate deliverables:
- Evidence matrix (stub attached) covering current state + gaps (we can populate gaps by Nov 12)
- A short internal triage call Wednesday 11/5 10:30 PT to assign owners

I attached a working evidence matrix (evidence_matrix_v0.3.xlsx) to speed review.

If that timeline looks tight, tell us which of the three items is highest priority for Legal.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Security Programs, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Dr. Amrita Singh <amrita@medsys.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security intake / audit evidence request

Adding implementation detail from Infra:
- Audit logs: events are captured at application + proxy layer; default retention is 90 days in hot storage, 365 days cold archival (S3). We can export CSV/JSON bundles on request.
- Granularity: per-request trace id, user_id (hashed), model_id, route, timestamp, and outcome (success/error). PII is redacted in logs by default.
- BYOK: we support customer-supplied KMS keys in our Dedicated offering today (KMS wrap/unwrapping handled by our runtime). For Hosted accounts, we currently offer a managed key with an exportable audit trail; HSM-backed customer keys are planned but not GA — ETA depends on commit.

Operational caveats: extending hot retention increases storage costs and may affect query latency for live traces; archival exports are straightforward. Happy to surface cost delta if MedSys wants 365-day hot retention.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Nov 2025 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security intake / audit evidence request

Thanks — product lens: we need to convert these asks into prioritization buckets so Eng can scope work for an evidence pack. Suggested buckets:
- Must-have before contract: exportable audit snapshots + SAML metadata + signed confirmation of BYOK support in Dedicated (tile we can commit)
- Next quarter: tooling for 365 hot retention opt-in + UI to request exports (low-lift backend first)
- Backlog: HSM customer key integration, SCIM provisioning (needs product spec)

Can we agree that the immediate focus is on producing a repeatable evidence artifact (CSV export + sign-off doc) and a short statement about BYOK coverage for Dedicated customers? If so I can allocate a small eng spike and product writer to assemble the pack.

Marissa Cole
Senior PM, Platform
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Dr. Amrita Singh <amrita@medsys.com>, Procurement <procure@medsys.com>
Date: Sun, 9 Nov 2025 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security intake / audit evidence request — next steps

Summary and actions from internal triage:
1) Scope to deliver for MedSys by Nov 18:
   - Audit export: engineering to produce CSV/JSON snapshot and sample query for the last 90 days. Owner: Ben Carter.
   - BYOK statement: product + security to draft a one-page confirmation that Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS keys; include current limitations (no HSM export). Owner: Marissa Cole + Irene Choi.
   - SSO metadata: security to share SAML metadata and attribute map. Owner: Karthik Iyer.
2) Deliverables location: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-MedSys-Evidence
3) Jira ticket created to track work: JIRA-9876 (label: medsys-evidence)
4) Follow-up: internal checkpoint 11/12 10:00 PT to review assembled evidence before sending to MedSys.

Amrita/Procurement — please confirm if immutable legal hold is required (that would change our timeline). Otherwise we will proceed on the export + statement path.

Thanks — Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Security Programs, Redwood Inference
